findings.source_passage: threadbare in coat, heart, body, and brain; I see him now. He was ever dusting his old lexicons and grammars, with a queer handkerchief, mockingly embellished
findings.source_locator: paragraph 1, opening description of the Usher
findings.why_it_matters: The quadruple 'threadbare' and the first-person intrusion 'I see him now' are voice-establishing and critically noted; 'mockingly embellished' carries ironic weight that 'gay-flagged' erases entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'threadbare in coat, heart, body, and brain; I see him now' and 'mockingly embellished with all the gay flags of all the known nations of the world' verbatim or near-verbatim.

findings.source_passage: He loved to dust his old grammars; it somehow mildly reminded him of his mortality.
findings.why_it_matters: This sentence is the interpretive keystone of the Etymology preface — the absurdist equation of lexicography with memento mori is one of the book's most-cited opening gestures; 'mindful of mortality' strips out the distinctive rhythm and the word 'somehow mildly' which carries all the ironic pathos.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore verbatim: 'He loved to dust his old grammars; it somehow mildly reminded him of his mortality.'

findings.why_it_matters: The Fijian and Erromangan entries are the climactic joke of the list — moving from Hebrew through European tongues to Pacific island languages; their absence destroys the comic and ethnographic arc that critics treat as central to Melville's encyclopedic ambition.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore both entries verbatim at the end of the word-list.

findings.source_passage: ‏חו‎, _Hebrew_. ϰητος, _Greek_. CETUS, _Latin_. WHŒL, _Anglo-Saxon_. HVALT, _Danish_. WAL, _Dutch_. HWAL, _Swedish_. HVALUR, _Icelandic_.
findings.why_it_matters: The full multilingual catalogue is the structural and rhetorical centrepiece of the Etymology segment; the draft retains only four of thirteen entries, obliterating the cumulative, encyclopedic effect that defines this passage's interpretive weight.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the complete word-list from Hebrew through Erromangan; these are proper nouns and cannot be further compressed without destroying the passage's meaning.

findings.source_passage: While you take in hand to school others, and to teach them by what name a whale-fish is to be called in our tongue
findings.why_it_matters: The draft retains only the letter-H clause, losing the rhetorical setup of the Hackluyt quotation; the full sentence is what gives the fragmentary retention intelligibility and period voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full Hackluyt quotation or at minimum enough of the opening clause to make the ellipsis intelligible in context.

summary: The draft catastrophically compresses the Etymology segment, losing the verbatim Usher characterisation, the full multilingual word-list (including the signature Pacific-island entries), and most of the Hackluyt epigraph — multiple high-severity signature failures that require regeneration.
